values_mathematically_equal.meaning: the two compared Float128 values are mathematically equal though their bit representations differ

equal_exponents_branch_reached.meaning: comparison reaches the main comparison logic branch where the two numbers have equal exponents

le_result_consistent.meaning: le() returns the same result for the mathematically equal values regardless of operand order/bit representation, so financial calculations relying on exact comparison are not misled

assumptions: The two compared values are Float128 encodings whose mathematical values are equal.
The comparison is performed by the le() function of Float128.sol.

unresolved.description: Report does not state concrete operand values or which operand order yields which result, so the consistency relation is represented as a single grounded Boolean rather than a per-order equality.

limitations: The financial-calculation impact is formalized only as the consistency of le() results for mathematically equal values; downstream financial consequences are not separately modeled.
Operand-order-specific outcomes are not distinguished because the report does not specify them.
